# Elastic Load Balancing (Classic) policies and traffic

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend the records-only Classic Load Balancer control plane with policies, placement changes and a data plane.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] Stickiness, SSL negotiation and backend authentication policies
- [ ] Attach/detach subnets, enable/disable Availability Zones and apply security groups
- [ ] Certificate lookup for HTTPS and SSL listeners
- [ ] Listener traffic and instance health checks
